name: LocalForge Brand Tokens
description: Canonical design tokens for LocalForge brand identity and Spatial Studio integration

night.description: Gece (Deep night purple) - Base canvas and darkest surface shadows

plum.description: Erik (Deep plum) - Dark spatial glass surfaces and panel cards

dusk.description: Alacakaranlık (Dusk) - Mid-tone purple background, panel borders, stages

violet.description: Menekşe (Violet) - Primary interactive accent, button gradients, active nav

lilac.description: Lila (Lilac) - The official brand hero color (elephant & shield rim), focus rings, high-contrast borders

mist.description: Sis (Mist) - Secondary text, micro-labels, subtle highlights on dark surfaces

white.description: Kar Beyazı (Snow white) - Primary typography on dark surfaces

healthy.description: Emerald Green - Strictly reserved for healthy verified processes and running projects

warning.description: Amber Orange - Strictly reserved for warnings, degraded runtimes, or unverified states

error.description: Ruby Red - Strictly reserved for errors, port conflicts, process crashes, or destructive guards

unknown.description: Neutral Slate - Strictly reserved for stopped projects, unprobed runtimes, or missing telemetry

display.value: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', sans-serif
